title: Concrete Pump Delivery Hose Quote Row
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Delivery Hose | Pinjin Xingtai Quote by DN
description: Pinjin delivery hose is a Xingtai rubber placing hose with steel couplings. Inner diameter and length are quoted after the pump model. No list price and no small-batch shipping. It is a different SKU from the straight steel pipe.
secondaryKeywords: concrete pump hose no list price

relatedPaths.label: Concrete pump delivery hose product page
Concrete pump hose vs steel pipe

answerBlock.what: Concrete Pump Delivery Hose is a flexible pipeline spare part manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Factory photos show bulk rubber placing hoses with steel couplings. Inner diameter and length are quoted after the pump model. No list price. Not sold in small batches. The page does not print a steel grade or a fixed DN.
answerBlock.who: Teams extending the flexible end of a listed Pinjin pump line, in project quantity, after DN and length are confirmed.
factors: No inner-diameter cell on this SKU
Straight steel pipe is a separate product page
A metre of hose is not automatically a metre of a pump’s printed distance
No list price

faqs.question: Does the delivery hose page print an inner diameter or a steel grade?
faqs.answer: No. Inner diameter and length are quoted after the pump model. Ends are steel couplings. No steel grade, no list price, and no small-batch shipping are printed.

faqs.question: Can one hose replace the straight delivery pipe SKU?
faqs.answer: No. The hose page and the straight-pipe page are separate parts. Quote each after the pump model, DN and length. See the hose-versus-steel note for why the line is not one SKU.
